meta.parties: Cathiresan Chetty v. Natchhiappa Chetty Et Al

rules.statement: A separate action to set aside a decree on the ground that it was obtained by fraud cannot be maintained where relief could have been had in the action in which the decree was entered.
rules.supporting_quote: "A separate action to set aside a decree on the ground that it was obtained by fraud cannot be brought where relief could have been had in the action in which the decree was entered."
